reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS month
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with signups
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(s.signups, 0) AS signups
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly s ON s.month = m.month

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS month FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) t(d)
), s AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month, COALESCE(s.signups, 0) AS signups
FROM months m LEFT JOIN s ON s.month = m.month
